scope: Nominal unloaded robot: equation verification and native-contact discrepancy study; no hardware validation
controller: Original nominal LQR; unchanged gains and total torque limit
fall_detection: At 5 ms control endpoints; native model checks pitch and roll
recovery: Final continuous dwell >=1 s within |pitch|<=1 deg, |x|<=0.03 m, |vx|<=0.03 m/s, after pulse end if nonzero

native_screen.meaning: Declared engineering discrepancy screen, not a physical-accuracy standard

selection: Full Cartesian grid and example fixed before executing this study. No gain tuning, parameter fitting, random sampling or statistical confidence intervals.
